title: Outer Shell for JRA: Swedish Saddlebags
content:
JRA’s Tim Willis fell in love with the Outer Shell Saddle Bags when he bought one from Box Dog Bikes in San Francisco some years ago. For JRA’s latest collaboration, he pinged the team at Outer Shell to make some Sweden-inspired Saddle Bags from 1000D Cordura from Seattle Fabrics and custom all-over print 15” Voile straps. If you just want the strap, go here.

Perfect for filling with Swedish Fish, meatballs or maybe just a flat fixing kit. Each bag will come with some BIKE stickers and other goodies. Use code PICKUP if you want to pick up locally in Seattle.

Scoop up at JRA.
